Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Andy m <maj...@majere.demon.co.uk> writes:
>All ammo cards state that only 1 ammo card and be used with a gun per
>combat,

>What if your vampire has 3 guns ??

>could you play BLUR
>then use a gun with MAN STOPPER rounds
>then use another gun with glasser rounds
>and then use your 3rd gun with dragons breath ???

>this would be about 9 points (min) with the last 2 being aggro

>Any answers ?

Yes, provided that the gun using glaser rounds had been used at least
once this combat before the round in question. The first time a given
gun is used in a given combat, it cannot use glaser rounds, as per
card text on glaser rounds.

Messages.Author: CurtAdams
Messages.Body:
Andy m <maj...@majere.demon.co.uk> writes:

>All ammo cards state that only 1 ammo card and be used

>with a gun per Combat,

>What if your vampire has 3 guns ??

>could you play BLUR
>then use a gun with MAN STOPPER rounds

>then use another gun with glaser rounds

>and then use your 3rd gun with dragons breath ???

Yes, provided that gun #2 had already been fired in the combat (a special
restriction on glaser rounds).

You can, however, fire the manstoppered gun more than once in a round,
provided you have the additional strikes, so there is rarely a reason to
combine manstopper and glaser rounds. A small sidearm for DBR is a
standard tactic.

Curt Adams (curt...@aol.com)
